rationale: The hypothesis is scientifically plausible and accompanied by a concrete experimental plan but lacks program-specific empirical support (orthogonal controls, EM/lipoprotein markers, stability) and quantified yield data. Recommend proceeding with the proposed orthogonal fractionation experiments, including lipoprotein/aggregate controls, yield benchmarking across ≥3 lots, and basic stability and small-animal/bridging exposure studies before adopting as a CMC identity gate.
